selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the value of this treatise even though it has some difficulties?
questions.answer: It says the treatise is still very important.

questions.question: Which person from early Islam is named as honoring this work?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: How did Imam Ali treat this part of the Risale-i Nur?
questions.answer: He gave it special attention and pointed people toward it.

questions.question: What does the phrase “true exposition” tell us about the treatise’s role?
questions.answer: It tells us the treatise is meant to clearly explain the verse.

questions.question: How is the Seventh Ray connected to the name Staff of Moses?
questions.answer: The passage says the Imam used that name for the Seventh Ray.

questions.question: What is covered in the Introduction?
questions.answer: Four important matters.

questions.question: What is found in the First Station?
questions.answer: The Arabic part of the explanation of the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: Why is the Introduction longer than the speaker first intended?
questions.answer: Because there was a need to explain more.

questions.question: What surprising opinion might some people still have about the Introduction?
questions.answer: Some may think it is still too short.

questions.question: How might readers react differently to the same Introduction?
questions.answer: Some may think it is too long, and others may think it is not long enough.

questions.question: What is one main idea of the first paragraph of the passage?
questions.answer: Even with its hard parts, the book is presented as very important.

questions.question: Who is said to have known about this work before it was written?
questions.answer: Imam Ali.

questions.question: What does the passage show by saying he directed people’s gaze toward it?
questions.answer: It shows that people should pay attention to it.

questions.question: Which title connects the work with Prophet Musa’s staff?
questions.answer: Staff of Moses.

questions.question: If a student wanted the Arabic explanation, which part should the student read?
questions.answer: The First Station.

questions.question: What is another way the passage identifies this treatise inside the Risale-i Nur?
questions.answer: It identifies it as the Seventh Ray.

questions.question: Did the speaker plan from the start to make the Introduction very long?
questions.answer: No. He says that was not his plan.

questions.question: What does the Introduction contain?
questions.answer: Four important matters.

questions.question: According to the verse, what is their purpose?
questions.answer: Their purpose is to worship Allah.

questions.question: What is the central duty mentioned in the final verse quoted here?
questions.answer: Worshipping Allah.

questions.question: What problem from earlier is mentioned at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: The book has flaws and is hard in some ways.

questions.question: Which noble companion is mentioned in connection with this treatise?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: What does the passage say Imam Ali did about this treatise?
questions.answer: He predicted it and gave it special names.

questions.question: What effect did that special favor have on people?
questions.answer: It directed their attention to this work.
